name: What considerations are unique for backsplash preparation in older homes in the Eagle area?

mainEntity.name: What considerations are unique for backsplash preparation in older homes in the Eagle area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes, such as those sometimes found in the Eagle area, often have plaster walls, uneven surfaces, or unique architectural features that require special attention. You might encounter multiple layers of old finishes, or even lead paint or asbestos in very old properties, though testing would be needed to confirm. Preparation may involve more extensive repairs, specialized primers for plaster, or careful handling of existing wall materials. Maine Results, Inc. has experience working with the distinct challenges of older home renovations, ensuring appropriate preparation methods for durable results.
